title: Private upgrades — observability metrics + dashboards (SRE wish list)
content:
Last updated: 2025-06-18 (Allison)

Why this doc exists
- We keep getting “upgrade felt scary / opaque” feedback for Private (VPC + on-prem). The new installer plan + precheck + backup + rollback work needs clear, consistent signals.
- This is the SRE list of metrics + dashboards we want BEFORE GA. It’s intentionally redundant; we’ll cut scope later.

Scope
- Upgrade workflow: prechecks → plan generation → backup/snapshot → control-plane rollout → data-plane rollout → DB migrations → postchecks → completion.
- Rollback workflow: rollback invoked → rollback hooks → restore backups (if applicable) → health verification.

Guiding principles
1) Every upgrade attempt must be measurable end-to-end.
2) Every failure mode must have a “what broke, where, and what to do next” view.
3) Metrics must allow us to answer: success rate, time to complete, where time is spent, and whether we burned error budget.
4) Labels must be controlled (no customer names; stable identifiers only; watch cardinality).

Required correlation IDs (applies to metrics, logs, traces)
- upgrade_id: UUID generated by installer at start; MUST be in all events.
- environment_id: stable ID for Private environment (what Support/SRE uses in tooling).
- deployment_mode: vpc | onprem
- from_version / to_version: semver (e.g., 2.19.3 → 2.20.0)
- installer_version: semver
- k8s_version: major.minor (e.g., 1.28)
- storage_backend: ebs-csi | ceph-rbd | longhorn | other (bucketed)
- region: cloud region or “onprem”

Optional but nice
- upgrade_channel: beta | ga
- change_window_id: maintenance window identifier (if provided via Terraform / operator input)

Metric naming conventions (proposal)
- Prefix: redwood_private_upgrade_* for installer/orchestrator metrics; redwood_private_migration_* for DB migration; redwood_private_precheck_* for precheck.
- Histograms for duration/size; counters for occurrences; gauges for “current state”.
- Label set should be consistent across metrics: environment_id, deployment_mode, from_version, to_version, installer_version.


========================
Metrics inventory (desired)
========================
Columns: metric_name | type | labels | emitted by | description | dashboards/panels | alerting notes

1) Upgrade attempt + lifecycle
- redwood_private_upgrade_attempt_total | counter | environment_id,deployment_mode,from_version,to_version,installer_version,trigger=manual|scheduled | installer | increment when upgrade is started (even if it fails immediately) | Upgrade overview | (none)
- redwood_private_upgrade_success_total | counter | same + reason=completed | installer | increment on completed success | Upgrade overview | success rate drop alert (rolling)
- redwood_private_upgrade_failure_total | counter | same + failure_stage,failure_code,blocking=yes|no | installer | increment on terminal failure | Upgrade overview + Failures | page if sustained failure rate during GA window
- redwood_private_upgrade_state | gauge | environment_id,upgrade_id,state | installer | current state machine state (prechecks, backup, cp_rollout, dp_rollout, migrations, postchecks, complete, failed, rolling_back, rolled_back) | Upgrade detail (single upgrade) | useful for stuck detection
- redwood_private_upgrade_time_to_complete_seconds | histogram | environment_id,deployment_mode,to_version | installer | total duration from start→success | Upgrade overview | alert if p95 regresses release-over-release

2) Prechecks
- redwood_private_precheck_run_total | counter | environment_id,precheck_suite=default|onprem,installer_version | installer | number of precheck runs | Precheck dashboard | (none)
- redwood_private_precheck_result_total | counter | environment_id,precheck_id,severity=block|warn|info,result=pass|fail|skip | installer | result count per precheck | Precheck dashboard | alert if block failures spike across envs after a release
- redwood_private_precheck_duration_seconds | histogram | environment_id,precheck_id | installer | runtime per precheck | Precheck dashboard | (none)
- redwood_private_precheck_blocking_failure_total | counter | environment_id,precheck_id,failure_code | installer | subset for block failures | Precheck dashboard | (none)

Precheck categories (we want to bucket by category label on result_total)
- category=k8s_health (node readiness, apiserver reachable)
- category=storage (headroom, pvc binding, snapshot support)
- category=rbac_auth (service account perms, OIDC reachability)
- category=networking (DNS, egress to artifact mirror, control plane connectivity)
- category=artifacts (chart availability, image digests, bundle verification)
- category=compatibility (version gate, k8s version gate)

3) Backup / snapshot
- redwood_private_backup_attempt_total | counter | environment_id,backup_type=snapshot|logical,storage_backend | installer | backup started | Backup/restore dashboard | (none)
- redwood_private_backup_success_total | counter | same | installer | backup completed | Backup/restore | page if success rate dips during beta
- redwood_private_backup_failure_total | counter | same + failure_code | installer | backup failed | Backup/restore | page if backup fails (rollback risk)
- redwood_private_backup_duration_seconds | histogram | environment_id,backup_type | installer | time to complete backup | Backup/restore | alert if p95 exceeds maintenance window budget
- redwood_private_restore_attempt_total | counter | environment_id,restore_type=snapshot|logical | installer | restore started (during rollback or manual restore) | Backup/restore | (none)
- redwood_private_restore_success_total | counter | same | installer | restore completed | Backup/restore | (none)
- redwood_private_restore_duration_seconds | histogram | environment_id,restore_type | installer | restore duration | Backup/restore | (none)

4) Helm rollout / Kubernetes jobs (control plane + data plane)
- redwood_private_helm_phase_duration_seconds | histogram | environment_id,phase=cp|dp,chart=control-plane|data-plane | installer | time per helm upgrade phase | Rollout dashboard | alert if cp phase p95 regresses
- redwood_private_k8s_job_failure_total | counter | environment_id,job_name,phase | installer (parsing) or in-cluster exporter | count failures for pre/post upgrade jobs | Rollout dashboard | page if job fails during upgrade window
- redwood_private_k8s_workload_unavailable_seconds | histogram | environment_id,workload,phase | in-cluster (kube-state-metrics derived) | unavailable time for deployments/statefulsets during upgrade | Rollout dashboard | watch for SLO impact

5) DB migrations
- redwood_private_migration_attempt_total | counter | environment_id,db=control|data,migration_id | app/migrator | increment per migration | Migration dashboard | (none)
- redwood_private_migration_duration_seconds | histogram | environment_id,db,migration_id | app/migrator | duration per migration | Migration dashboard | alert if p95 or max exceeds threshold (lock timeout risk)
- redwood_private_migration_failure_total | counter | environment_id,db,migration_id,failure_code=lock_timeout|deadlock|syntax|unknown | app/migrator | failure count | Migration dashboard | page on lock_timeout spikes
- redwood_private_migration_lock_wait_seconds | histogram | environment_id,db | app/db instrumentation | lock wait time distribution | Migration dashboard | (none)
- redwood_private_migration_guardrail_trigger_total | counter | environment_id,guardrail=lock_timeout_set|idempotency_check_failed|unsafe_ddl_blocked | app/migrator | number of times guardrails intervene | Migration dashboard | (none)

6) Rollback
- redwood_private_rollback_invoked_total | counter | environment_id,from_version,to_version,reason=operator|auto | installer | rollback started | Rollback dashboard | page if rollback invoked (severity depends on customer tier)
- redwood_private_rollback_success_total | counter | environment_id | installer | rollback completed and verified | Rollback dashboard | (none)
- redwood_private_rollback_failure_total | counter | environment_id,failure_stage,failure_code | installer | rollback failed | Rollback dashboard | page immediately (high severity)
- redwood_private_rollback_duration_seconds | histogram | environment_id | installer | duration | Rollback dashboard | (none)
- redwood_private_rollback_hook_result_total | counter | environment_id,hook_name,result=pass|fail|skip | installer | results for hooks | Rollback dashboard | (none)

7) Error budget / customer impact (SLO surface)
Goal: We need to attribute error spikes and latency regressions to upgrades without arguing in incidents.

- redwood_private_upgrade_window_active | gauge | environment_id,upgrade_id | installer → annotation service (preferred) | 1 during an active upgrade window (start→end) | SLO dashboard annotations | used to filter/overlay
- redwood_api_request_errors_total | counter | environment_id,route,code_class=4xx|5xx | control plane + data plane gateways | baseline app errors | Error budget impact dashboard | existing alerts; add “upgrade overlay”
- redwood_api_request_latency_seconds | histogram | environment_id,route | gateways | request latency | Error budget impact | alert tuned by tier
- redwood_private_inference_error_rate | gauge or derived | environment_id,model_family | data plane | aggregate inference errors (timeouts/oom) | Error budget impact | watch during dp rollout
- redwood_private_control_plane_connectivity_failures_total | counter | environment_id | control plane agent | connectivity issues during upgrade | Error budget impact | page if sustained

Derived metrics (dashboard-only; calculated in PromQL/DataDog/etc.)
- Upgrade success rate = success_total / attempt_total (by to_version, deployment_mode)
- Upgrade rollback rate = rollback_invoked_total / attempt_total
- Precheck block fail rate by category
- Migration p95 per to_version
- Error budget burn during upgrade window (two-window burn rates + overlay)


========================
Dashboards (proposed)
========================
A) “Private Upgrades — Fleet Overview” (SRE + Release Eng)
Purpose: Release-quality readout (did this release make upgrades worse?)
Panels
- Attempts / success / failure by to_version (last 7d / 30d)
- Median + p95 time_to_complete_seconds by to_version, deployment_mode
- Top failure_stage and failure_code (stacked bar)
- Rollback_invoked_total trend + rollback reasons
- Precheck block failures by category (heatmap)
- Migration p95 duration by to_version (control DB vs data DB)

B) “Private Upgrade — Single Environment / Single Upgrade Detail” (on-call)
Purpose: debug a live/stuck upgrade
Inputs: environment_id + upgrade_id
Panels
- upgrade_state gauge over time
- phase durations (prechecks, backup, cp, dp, migrations, postchecks)
- last 50 installer log lines (if we can embed) + links to support bundle
- k8s job failures during the window
- error rate + latency overlay during the window

C) “Prechecks — Failures and Remediation” (Support + on-call)
Purpose: reduce support load; quickly bucket why customers are blocked
Panels
- block vs warn ratio by precheck_id
- block failures by category (top N)
- block failures by deployment_mode and storage_backend
- links: “remediation doc for precheck_id” (not a metric; dashboard metadata)

D) “Migrations — Duration, Locks, Guardrails” (DB + SRE)
Panels
- migration_duration_seconds p50/p95/max by migration_id and to_version
- migration_failure_total by failure_code
- lock_wait_seconds p95 trend
- guardrail_trigger_total trend

E) “Backup/Restore Health” (SRE)
Panels
- backup success rate by backup_type + storage_backend
- backup duration p95 by storage_backend
- restore attempts (should mostly be during drills/incidents)

F) “Rollback Health” (SRE + Product)
Panels
- rollback invoked and success rate
- rollback duration p95
- rollback_hook_result_total failures by hook_name

G) “Error Budget Impact (Upgrade Overlay)” (SRE leadership / postmortems)
Panels
- request error rate + latency (baseline) with upgrade window annotations
- burn rate (1h, 6h) with overlay; show “upgrade_active=1” periods
- incidents labeled upgrade-related (from incident-bot annotations)


========================
Alerting (initial proposals)
========================
- Rollback invoked (any) for tier=enterprise environments: page on-call + notify Release Eng channel.
- Rollback failure (any): page immediately (highest severity).
- Migration lock timeout spikes: page if >N in 15m across any env OR p95 lock_wait_seconds crosses threshold.
- Upgrade failures spike by to_version: ticket + slack alert to eng-releases; page only if customer-impact signals also spike.
- Stuck upgrade: upgrade_state not progressing for > X minutes in phases backup/migrations/cp/dp.


========================
Implementation notes / open questions
========================
Where metrics come from
- Installer CLI (redwood-private-installer): should emit lifecycle/precheck/backup/rollback metrics. Ideally uses OTEL metrics exporter; fallback to pushing to control plane collector.
- In-cluster components (control plane + data plane): emit migration and runtime SLO metrics.
- Helm hooks/jobs: some signals may come from installer observing job status; avoid scraping every job label (cardinality).

Cardinality guardrails
- DO NOT label metrics with: customer name, cluster name, node name, pod UID.
- job_name should be normalized (preupgrade-job, migrate-job) not full release name.
- migration_id should be bounded (we control list). If too many, keep migration_id in logs only and bucket by “migration_group”.

Audit events vs metrics
- Metrics answer “how many/how long”; audit logs answer “who/what/when”. We still need both.
- Ensure audit events include upgrade_id and match the metric upgrade_id.

Error budget overlay
- We need a reliable “upgrade window active” annotation source.
  Option 1: installer emits start/stop events → control plane writes annotation → dashboards query it.
  Option 2: create a lightweight “maintenance window” object per environment.

On-prem constraints
- Some on-prem customers won’t ship telemetry externally. We need a mode where metrics land in their Prometheus/Grafana bundle.
- If we have to choose, prioritize: precheck failures, migration duration, rollback counts, and “upgrade state stuck”.

Next actions (proposed)
- (Allison) Align metric names + labels with observability-pack PR-778 and update dashboard JSON templates.
- (Sahana) Ensure e2e upgrade tests emit metrics in CI to validate dashboards don’t go dark.
- (Rafael/Sean) Confirm alert routing + paging policy during beta (design partners) vs GA.
- (Connor) Add release checklist item: “upgrade dashboards reviewed for new release candidate.”
